versions.localizedDescription:
A small build update for 0.9 with a number of bug fixes.

• Fixed some pages not loading in webtoon reader
• Improved webtoon reader memory usage (hopefully fixes crash after reading multiple chapters)
• Fixed crash when searching anywhere in the macOS app
• Various other bug fixes
